clauses.clause: Army compound: ≥ 8 soldiers, ≥ 2 military vehicles, ≥ 2 buses with civilians; no active infected in the 5 s rest; ring visible during the camera pull-back; evacuation wait **15 s**.
clauses.note: Fresh low/high actual mortal native complete snapshots, replayed through production loadResume without actor edits/protection/skips. All20 cited original1280×720 captures opened. Nine actual150HP soldiers, truck+APC and two EVAC buses visible; five waiting civilians stand outside northern bus. FAIL presentation: both bus close views have opaque blank gray windows and no visible seated civilian silhouettes; E21 §5.10 and AC17 explicitly require buses with seated civilians visible. Before-ring rest measured every tick for300ticks/5s at x217:0 active infected inside compound (x>213,abs(z)<27), HP100 throughout, both tiers. Physical KeyS+KeyD enters ring at tick400; production camera radius59.882m with green ring visible in entered-ring capture. Input released; exact doneAt1300−crossedAt400=900ticks/15s in both tiers. Wait5s close views show ring, standing civilians and HUD10s remaining. Overview shows towers, two buses, military vehicles and outside attackers; no claim that all bus occupants are invisible from every possible camera, but required visible seated population is absent in reviewed close and normal pullback views.
